recipes.name: Creamy Harissa Pasta
instructions: Cook the pasta according to the package instructions, stopping 1 minute before al dente. Reserve ½ cup of the pasta cooking water before draining*.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a sauté pan over medium-high heat. While the oil heats up, chop the onion and add it to the pan to cook for 4 to 5 minutes, until golden.
While the onion cooks, mince the garlic and chop the roasted red peppers and spinach.

Add the garlic and cook for 1 to 2 minutes, stirring often, until lightly golden. Add the tomato paste, bouillon, harissa, oregano, paprika, and salt. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes more, stirring throughout to toast.
Add the reserved cooking water to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the drained pasta, cooking cream, peas, nutritional yeast, pine nuts, roasted red peppers, and spinach. Cook until heated through and the spinach has wilted.
Add the lemon zest and juice, and toss to combine.
Plate, and garnish with fresh basil, seasoned toasted bread crumbs, or vegan parmesan, if desired. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Harissa sauce is typically a thinner, milder form of harissa paste, blended with additional oil, tomatoes, or other liquids for a pourable consistency. It's available in both mild and hot varieties. For this recipe, we used the milder version. * The amount of reserved pasta water is based on the original recipe, which makes 4 servings. If you've scaled the recipe, adjust the amount accordingly.
Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days. Reheat in a pan over low to medium heat, adding a splash of water or plant milk to loosen the sauce if needed.
